articles.title: White House Releases Executive Orders on Quantum Computing
articles.intro: The orders direct federal agencies to prepare to defend against cryptographic attacks and contribute to U.S. quantum computing innovation.

articles.title: White House Releases National Security Science & Technology Strategy
articles.intro: The document highlights the importance of leadership in emerging technologies and warns of losing the advantage to China.

articles.title: White House Unveils Program to Authorize Private-Sector Cyber Surveillance and Disruption Operations
articles.intro: The Aug. 12 presidential memorandum directing the creation of a private-sector hacking program raises novel questions for participants.
